description: This file defines a ValidationService class that manages execution, storage, and retrieval of data validation runs and reports within a data validation framework. It includes methods for executing validation checks, storing reports in a file system with tamper-evident hashes, and querying validation results, all with a focus on data asset validation processes.

classes.name: ValidationService
classes.description: Service class providing methods for executing validations, managing reports, and querying validation data.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] execute_validation_run( self, data_asset_id: str, profile: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Performs a validation run for a specified data asset with a given profile, storing a report and returning validation details.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _execute_checks(self, data_asset_id: str, profile: str)
methods.description: Runs validation checks on a data asset based on its profile, including metadata and state validation.

methods.name: None _store_report(self, storage_ref: str, content: str)
methods.description: Stores validation reports on disk in a tamper-evident manner, using a hash for integrity verification.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_validation_report(self, validation_run_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a stored validation report and its metadata by validation run ID.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_latest_validation_for_data_asset(self, data_asset_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches the most recent validation run details for a specific data asset.
